purpose: P003 R1 production capacity read-only inspection before configuration change

inspection_time.note: The capacity inspection completed after the candidate test log timestamp and before this record was written. Its individual tool result did not include an exact wall-clock timestamp; no timestamp was invented and no production query was repeated.

measurement.capacity_check: bavail_bytes must be at least min_free_disk_bytes + payload_bytes * 4 + 65536

database.query_mode: SQLite file URI mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON

verification.probe_artifact_note: The initial malformed SQLite URI briefly created an empty 0-byte probe filename. Its size was verified and that artifact was removed before the correct read-only query; the real business database was not written.

recommendation.rationale: A 2 GiB floor leaves about 4.05 GiB of current headroom while the total business payload remains capped at 32 MiB and 10000 records. Monitor whole-filesystem growth separately.

before.failure: raw record fixture accepted: capacity_exceeded instead of accepted

isolated_test.change: Only this isolated test sets its minimum free disk reserve to 1 byte; product code and production settings remain unchanged.
